description: The account review's own words in languages beyond English and Chinese: section titles, scope line, citation facts and the public identity line. Keys match TEXT in scripts/compose_review.py; placeholders must stay unchanged. A language listed here renders the whole report in that language, so the host may deliver it as is. Any other language renders these words in English and the reply translates them.
